inlines.v: SURREPTI'TIOUS, adjective [Latin surreptitius, supra.] Done by stealth or without proper authority; made or introduced fraudulently; as a surreptitious passage in a manuscript. A correct copy of the Dunciad, the many surreptitious ones have rendered necessary.
